import React from 'react'; import PageBanner from '../components/PageBanner'; const PrivacyPolicy = () => ( <>

Last updated: Recently

At B.unique ("we", "us"), we value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This policy explains what we collect and how we use it.

1. Information We Collect

  • Account data: name, email address and phone number.
  • Order data: order history, payment method and transaction references.
  • Technical data: IP address, browser type and pages visited to improve our service.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To process and deliver your orders.
  • To manage your account and provide customer support.
  • To send order updates, receipts and important notifications.
  • To improve our website, products and customer experience.

3. Data Security

We use appropriate security measures to protect your personal data. Payment details are handled securely, and we never store sensitive payment information on our servers.

4. Cookies

Our website may use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and remember your preferences.

5. Third-Party Services

We may share necessary information with trusted service providers only to fulfill orders and operate our business.

6. Your Rights

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us.

7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. Continued use of the site indicates acceptance of any changes.

); export default PrivacyPolicy;
